name: Segla
why: A steep climb to a sharp fin of rock 639 m straight above the Mefjord, the symbol of the island of Senja.
dangers: Steep, loose and exposed near the top.
Do not go in wet or windy weather.

points.name: Fjordgård
points.note: A fishing village below the mountain.

points.name: Segla
points.note: A pointed peak like a sail above the fjord.
